lemmas.primary_translation: court of appeal consisting of three professional judges and four lay judges

definitions.text: lagmannsrett som i visse saker består av tre fagdommere og fire domsmenn som sammen avgjør både skyldspørsmålet og straffeutmålingen
definitions.translation: a court of appeal which, in certain cases, consists of three professional judges and four lay judges who together decide both the question of guilt and the sentence
